verifiable-quality-gates.why: each of the four arch-gate fixes ships a discrimination test: an empty .catch arrow is flagged while a non-empty one passes (#124), the summary reports evaluated-not-walked (#127), a Python except: pass is flagged and a no-code tree warns (#146), and an unreadable file fails closed exit 2 (#149)
verifiable-quality-gates.what: added ISSUE-124/127/146/149 tests and kept the existing detection + ReDoS tests green; recomputed the arch-gate manifest sha
quotes: test must FAIL when the check is replaced by a no-op

architectural-decision-records.why: the detection/reporting hardening (fail-closed posture, evaluated count, Python coverage, arrow-catch) is architecturally significant and recorded in one ADR
architectural-decision-records.what: wrote ADR-0074 documenting the four fixes, the fail-closed posture, and the honest scope of the Python built-in
quotes: Every architecturally significant change ships with an ADR in the same unit of work

comprehensive-test-strategy.why: each fix is pinned at the level that owns it, an integration test that runs the real arch-gate against a fixture reproducing the exact condition
comprehensive-test-strategy.what: fixture-based tests for the arrow catch, the evaluated count, the Python except, the no-code warning, and the unreadable-file fail-closed
quotes: Test at the lowest level that can catch the bug, and match the test type to the risk.

bdd-comprehensive-testing.why: the non-happy paths were enumerated and committed: empty vs non-empty arrow catch, a Python except: pass, a no-code tree, and an unreadable file
bdd-comprehensive-testing.what: added those as node:test cases, each asserting the real exit code / output
quotes: These are not optional and not left to judgment.

skeptical-audit.why: the ADR states the honest scope: the Python built-in is a minimal floor not a full linter, and the 0-code warning keeps the JS/TS-plus-Python coverage claim honest rather than implying total language coverage
skeptical-audit.what: recorded the scope and the fail-closed rationale in ADR-0074
quotes: If you cannot attach all three, you do not assert it

judge-arch.why: a fresh-context review was run on the arch-gate delta before the PR, with explicit ReDoS, false-positive, and fail-closed-aggressiveness scrutiny
judge-arch.what: ran judge-arch in a fresh subagent and recorded it in the arch-review log
quotes: These are not optional and not left to discretion. Every review does all of them.

owasp-secure-coding-bdd.why: no input, auth, session, crypto, upload or dependency surface changed; the fail-closed-on-unreadable posture is a gate-integrity property, pinned by a test, not a new security surface; the new regexes were checked for ReDoS

pattern-selector.why: no new feature, class, module or data flow; the Python built-ins reuse the existing built-in-check array shape

arch-encode.why: the fixes are enforced by discrimination tests, not a new rules-file entry

compliance-data-lifecycle.why: no PII, retention, migration, backup or audit logic; this is gate detection logic

enterprise-architecture-standards.why: no system, service, database or integration architecture changed

release-deployment-safety.why: no deploy, migration, feature-flag or rollback mechanism changed; rides 1.3.1 with a sha recompute

sre-operational-readiness.why: no SLI/SLO, alert, runbook or production-operability surface changed

universal-accessibility-wcag.why: no user-facing or UI surface; developer-facing gate tooling

universal-browser-device-support.why: no frontend or browser-facing code; developer-facing gate tooling

usability-ux-universal-design.why: no user-facing flow, screen, form or copy; developer-facing gate tooling
